questions.question: (a) He put his (b) sign on the footer of the (c) letter and posted it. (d) No error
questions.solution: replace 'sign' with 'signature'. 'sign' ki jagah 'signature' aayega kyunki 'sign' verb hoti hai aur 'signature' noun hota hai, sentence mein 'his' adjective ke baad noun ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'signature' sahi hoga. Note:- 'sign' noun hota hai jab iska matlab 'koi mark, symbol, gesture' hota hai,

questions.question: (a) Nowadays he is living (b) in foreign but (c) his parents live in India (d) No error
questions.solution: replace 'in foreign' with 'abroad'. 'foreign' word ek adjective hai aur 'in' preposition ka object nahi ban sakta, isliye 'in a foreign country' yaa fir 'abroad' ka use hoga kyunki 'adverb of place' banana hai. Dono mein se 'abroad' prefer karenge.

questions.question: (a) The english teacher (b) asked us to revise (c) the chapter that he taught yesterday (d) No error
questions.solution: replace 'The English teacher' with 'The teacher of English'. 'english teacher' ka matlab 'angrez teacher', lekin sentence ka matlab chahiye 'English padhaane wala teacher' jiske liye sahi term 'the teacher of english' hogi.

questions.question: (a) Unless you don't study (b) hard, you won't (c) be able to crack this exam. (d) no error
questions.solution: replace 'unless you don't' with 'unless you'. 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai, jisme 'not' pehle se understood hota hai isliye 'unless/until' jis clause mein aata hai uss clause mein 'not' ka use nahi hota, isliye 'unless you study' sahi hoga

questions.question: (a) You should know (b) that he is my cousin brother and you should not (c) misbehave with him again. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'brother' after 'cousin'. 'cousin' ke sath 'brother' yaa 'sister' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'cousin' pehle se hee noun hai, isliye 'cousin' ke sath 'brother' yaa 'sister' superfluous ki category mein aata hai.

questions.question: (a) You should not worry (b) because the company will reimburse back (c) the money you spent (d) during your official visit to Lucknow.
questions.solution: remove 'back'. 'reimburse' ka matlab hee hota hai 'give back, waapas lautaana', isliye iske sath 'back' superfluous ki category mein aata hai.

questions.question: (a) These firms which are (b) the main suppliers of electronic (c) components in India. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'which'. sentence mein 'which' nahi aayega kyunki 'which' relative pronoun se adjectival clause bana hai jiski verb 'are' hai. Lekin 'firms' subject ko verb nahi mili poore sentence mein, isliye yahan 'which' hata denge, jisse 'firms' subject ki verb 'are' ho jaayegi. Sentence mein ek hee clause hai.

questions.question: (a) It is not difficult to believe (b) that a man who has lived in this city for a long time he will never feel (c) at home anywhere else in the world. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'he'. 'will never feel' verb ka subject 'a man' banega jo 'who was...' wale adjectival clause se pehle likha hai. 'He' laga denge toh 'a man' subject ko verb hi nahi milegi. Isliye yahan 'he' hatana padega.

questions.question: (a) What you had said about (b) the employees it was found to be (c) correct but it could not be proved. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'it'. 'what you had said about the employees' yeh poora noun clause hai jo 'was found' verb ka subject banega. Isliye yahan 'it' pronoun ka use superfluous hai.

questions.question: (a) He was very (b) friendly enough to help (c) me when I was in distress. (d) no error
questions.solution: Remove 'very'. 'very' aur 'enough' ek sath use nahi hote yaa toh 'very friendly' hoga yaa 'friendly enough' hoga, lekin aage 'to help' infinitive diya hai jiske sath 'enough' sahi hota hai isliye yahan 'very' ko hata denge.

questions.question: (a) The passing marks in (b) this paper are thirty three (c) but you have got just thirty. (d) No error
questions.solution: Use 'pass marks' in place of 'passing marks'. 'passing marks' ka matlab 'passing hote hue marks', lekin matlab chahiye 'pass hone ke liye marks' jiske liye 'pass marks' sahi term hoti hai.

questions.question: (a) They stayed in (b) kashmir for a short period (c) of time and (d) then returned home.
questions.solution: remove 'of time' after period. 'period' ka matlab hee 'time' hota hai. Isliye iske sath 'of time' superfluous hai.

questions.question: (a) The principal forbade (b) the students not to (c) stage a walk out. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'not'. 'forbid' verb mein 'not' pehle se hee understood hota hai aur iska matlab 'kisi ko kuch kaam karne se rokna/mana karna'. Isliye iske sath 'not' nahi aayega.

questions.question: (a) Probably by the end (b) of the year he will have left (c) for the USA with bag and baggage. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'with' before 'bag and baggage'. 'bag and baggage' ka matlab 'with all your belongings' Yeh ek idiom hai jo adverb ki tarah kaam karta hai iske pehle 'with' ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: (a) The short story (b) should not exceed more than two (c) hundred words. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'more than'. 'exceed' ka meaning hi hota hai 'more than something' iske sath 'more than' lagana superfluous hai.

questions.question: (a) We have signed (b) a mutual agreement (c) with the other party. (d) No error
questions.solution: Use 'an agreement' in place of 'a mutual agreement'. jab bhi koi 'agreement' sign hota hai wo mutually hee sign hota hai, isliye 'agreement' ke sath 'mutual' superfluous hota hai. aur 'agreement' ke according 'an' article aayega.

questions.question: (a) He doesn't hardly know (b) anything about the real (c) actors that caused that accident. (d) No error
questions.solution: Replace 'doesn't hardly know' with 'hardly knows'. Use either 'he hardly knows anything' or 'he does not know anything', kyunki 'hardly' ka matlab 'naa ke barabar' jisme 'not' pehle se understood hai. isliye 'hardly' ke sath negative word ka use nahi hota hai.

questions.question: (a) Reason why most (b) people get trapped in MLM schemes (c) is because that they want (d) to become rich overnight.
questions.solution: Remove 'because'. 'because' ek reason ko batane wali conjunction hai aur agar sentence mein 'reason' word ka use ho chuka hai toh 'because' nahi aayega. aur 'that' conjunction ka kaam karega.

questions.question: (a) Throughout the whole year, (b) there was not even (c) a single day without (d) violence in this city.
questions.solution: remove 'whole'. 'throughout' ka matlab hee hota hai 'poora', isliye iske sath baad 'whole' lagana superfluous ho jaayega.

questions.question: (a) While walking in (b) the park, I came across (c) by chance my friend Rajat (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'by chance'. 'come across' ka matlab he hota hai 'kisi se achaanak milna' iske baad 'by chance' yaa 'suddenly' lagana superfluous ho jaata hai.

questions.question: (a) He asked me (b) that why I had not met Rajesh (c) after the interview. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'that'. sentence indirect speech mein likha hai, toh 'asked' verb ke baad 'how, why, where, when' yehi conjunction ka kaam karte hai aur iss sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction nahi aayegi.

questions.question: (a) I asked him if (b) he had sufficient enough money (c) to pay the rent. (d) No error
questions.solution: use either 'sufficient' or 'enough'. dono ka meaning same hota hai 'paryapt'. Note:- agar yeh alag alag part mein aate toh 'enough' ko rakhte aur 'sufficient' ko remove karna prefer karte kyunki aage infinitive diya hai.

questions.question: (a) He asked me (b) Supposing if they didn't come (c) what we would do. (d) No error
questions.solution: use either 'if' or 'Supposing'. kyunki yeh dono conjunctions hain aur dono ka meaning same hai toh dono mein se koi ek use karenge.

questions.question: (a) They were not (b) able to cross the bridge (c) despite of their best efforts. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'of' after 'despite'. 'in spite of' = 'despite' (ke babjood) 'despite' ke baad 'of' ka use nahi hota hai.

questions.question: (a) Whether you (b) believe it or not (c) I know that it is a true fact. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'true' before 'fact'. 'fact' humesha ussi ko bolte hai jo 'true' ho. Isliye 'fact' ke sath 'true' superfluous hota hai.

questions.question: (a) I couldn't come here (b) yesterday because (c) it was raining like cats and dogs. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'like'. 'raining cats and dogs' ka matlab 'rain heavily' Yeh ek idiom hai jo adverb ki tarah kaam karta hai isliye iske pehle 'like' preposition ka use nahi karte.

questions.question: (a) The teacher was angry (b) because the (c) students didn't give the test. (d) No error
questions.solution: replace 'didn't give' with 'didn't take'. hindi mein hum kehte hain 'students ne test diya' but english mein correct usage 'take the test' hoti hai. Eg. All the students took their final exam yesterday

questions.question: (a) A light breeze (b) was blowing which helped (c) the child go to sleep. (d) No error
questions.solution: Remove 'light' before 'breeze'. 'breeze' ka matlab hee 'light wind' hota hai, isliye iske sath 'light' superfluous hoga. Note:- 'helped the child go to sleep' me 'go' bare infinitive hai.

questions.question: (a) The speed of the (b) car decreased when it (c) approached near the toll plaza. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'near'. 'approach' ek transitive verb jiske baad object aate hai, isliye iske baad 'near' preposition galat hogi. aur 'approach' ka matlab 'kisi ke pass pahuchna' jiske sath 'near' superfluous hota hai.

questions.question: (a) I request you (b) to kindly help me in (c) decorating this room. (d) No error
questions.solution: remove 'kindly'. 'request' and 'kindly' sath mein superfluous maane jaate hain. 'I request you to help me...', 'Kindly help me in....' Inme se ek structure ka use sahi hota hai. Yahan sentence parts mein divided hai isliye b part mein se 'kindly' ko remove karna hi option hai.

questions.question: While finalising the (a)/ lengthy rental agreement, the landlord (b)/ requested the tenant to put her sign (c)/ on each page of the contract. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'sign' with 'signature'. 'sign' ki jagah 'signature' hoga kyunki 'sign' verb hoti hai aur 'signature' noun hota hai, sentence mein 'her' adjective hai jiske baad noun ki jarurat hai, isliye 'signature' noun sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: His elder sister has been (a)/ working in foreign for more than (b)/ five years, although she frequently visits home (c)/ to spend time with her parents. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'in foreign' with 'abroad'. Sentence mein 'in foreign' ki jagah 'abroad' aayega kyunki 'in' preposition ke baad object ki jarurat hai, lekin 'foreign' adjective hota hai, isliye 'in foreign' ko hatake 'abroad' adverb of place se bhi wahi meaning aayega, isliye 'abroad' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While conducting a practice session, (a)/ the English teacher advised the students to revise the grammar rules (b)/ thoroughly before attempting the practice questions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the English teacher' with 'the teacher of English'. 'the English teacher' ka matlab hoga 'angrej teacher', lekin sentence mein matlab chaiye 'english padhane wala teacher' jiske liye 'the teacher of english' sahi term hoga. Ex:- 'the german teacher' ka matlab 'aisa teacher jo Germany se belong karta ho'.

questions.question: Unless she doesn't submit (a)/ all the required documents her application (b)/ for the scholarship will not be processed. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'doesn't submit' with 'submits'. 'unless' ka matlab hota hai 'agar nahi' jisme 'not' pehle se hee hota hai, isliye 'doesn't' yahan superfluous hoga, isliye 'she' ke according 'submits' singular verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: He warned them that the boy (a)/ they were making fun of was his cousin brother (b)/ and that such behaviour would not be tolerated by him. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'brother' after 'cousin'. 'cousin' ke sath brother yaa sister ka use nahi hota kyunki 'cousin' pehle se hee noun hai, isliye 'cousin' ke sath 'brother yaa sister' superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'brother' nahi aayega. sentence mein 'boy' se pata chal gaya hai.

questions.question: You need not worry (a)/ because the finance department (b)/ has assured that it will reimburse back all the travel expenses. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'back' after 'reimburse'. 'reimburse' ka matlab hee hota hai 'give back, waapas lautana', isliye iske sath 'back' superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'back' nahi aayega.

questions.question: These programmes which play a crucial (a)/role in enhancing employment opportunities (b)/ in several underdeveloped regions. (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'which'. Sentence mein 'which' nahi aayega kyunki 'which' se adjectival clause bana hai jiski verb 'play' hai, lekin 'programs' subject ko verb nahi mili poore sentence mein, isliye yahan 'which' relative pronoun ho hata denge, jisse 'play' verb 'programs' subject ke liye verb ban jaayegi.

questions.question: A student who has worked consistently (a)/throughout the year he will surely perform well (b)/ in the final examinations that the university conducts annually. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'he' after 'year'. Sentence mein 'he' pronoun nahi aayega kyunki 'who....se lekar...the year' tak clause bana hai, aur 'student' subject ki verb 'will' banegi, isliye yahan 'he' pronoun ko hatana padega, jisse 'will' verb 'student' subject ko mil paaye.

questions.question: The villagers decided to rebuild (a)/the old community hall again after (b)/ it got damaged in the heavy storm. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'again' after 'hall'. Sentence mein 'again' nahi aayega kyunki 'rebuild' ka matlab hee hota hai 'dubara banana', isliye 'again' adverb superfluous hoga.

questions.question: The athlete was very (a)/ strong enough to complete the entire marathon (b)/ despite the harsh weather conditions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'very'. Sentence mein 'very' aur 'enough' sath mein nahi aapayenge kyunki yaa toh 'very strong' hota yaa 'strong enough', lekin aage infinitive likhna hai aur infinitive ke sath 'enough' sahi hota hai, isliye yahan 'very' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: The students are angry because (a)/ the passing marks have been increased to fifty percent (b)/ by the institution just before the final examinations (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'passing marks' with 'pass marks'. 'passing marks' ka matlab hota hai 'pass hote hue marks', lekin hume yeh kehna hai ki 'pass hone ke liye marks' isliye yahan 'pass marks' sahi term hoti hai, isliye 'pass marks' sahi hoga.

questions.question: They worked in (a)/ this remote village for a brief period of time (b)/ before shifting to the nearby town (c)/ to start their new business venture. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'of time' before 'period'. Sentence mein 'of time' nahi aayega kyunki 'period' ka matlab hee 'time' hota hai, isliye yahan 'a brief period' ke sath 'of time' nahi aayega.

questions.question: The coach forbade (a)/ the players not to (b)/ consume junk food during the training period (c)/ as it could negatively affect their performance. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'not'. 'forbade' verb mein 'not' pehle se hee understood hai aur iska matlab 'kisi ko kuch kaam karne se rokna/mana karna', isliye iske sath 'not' nahi aayega.

questions.question: At the end of the semester (a)/ the professor will leave the institute (b)/ for his hometown with bag and baggage. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'with'. Sentence mein 'bag and baggage' ek adverb ki tarah se kaam karne wala structure hai, aur isse pehle preposition nahi aati, isliye yahan 'with' preposition nahi aayegi.

questions.question: The final report (a)/ should not exceed more than fifty pages (b)/ as the committee has instructed all researchers (c)/ to keep the documentation concise and precise. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'more than'. Sentence mein 'more than' nahi aayega kyunki 'exceed' ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi cheez se jyada', isliye iske sath 'more than' superfluous ho jaayega, isliye yahan 'more than' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Rohit mentioned that (a)/ his company had recently signed a mutual agreement (b)/ with a logistics firm of Mumbai (c)/ to streamline deliveries across Maharashtra. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'mutual'. Jab bhi koi 'agreement' sign hote hai wo mutually he sign hota hai, isliye 'agreement' ke sath 'mutual' superfluous hoga. aur 'mutual' ko hatane se 'agreement' ke according 'an' article bhi aayega.

questions.question: Anjali doesn't hardly remember anything (a)/ about the chain-snatching incident (b)/ that took place when she was ten years old. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'hardly' or 'doesn't'. 'hardly' ka matlab he hota hai 'naa ke barabar' isme pehle se hee 'not' understood hota hai, isliye 'hardly' yaa 'doesn't' mein se koi ek word aayega.

questions.question: The reason why many youngsters (a)/ fall for online investment scams (b)/ is because they blindly trust influencers (c)/ who promise unrealistic returns in a few days. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'because' with 'that'. Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'reason' ka matlab he hota hai 'kaaran' aur 'because' ka bhi 'kaaran' matlab hota hai, isliye yahan 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'kii' wala meaning chaiye, general structure 'the reason is that' hota hai. isliye yahan 'because' ki jagah 'that' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He reiterated his point again (a)/ during the discussion hoping that the committee (b)/ would finally pay attention to his proposal. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'again'. 'reiterated' ka matlab hee hota hai 'say again, dohraana', isliye iske sath 'again' superfluous hoga, isliye 'again' nahi aayega.

questions.question: While travelling to Pune for an official meeting, (a)/ I came across by chance (b)/ an old schoolmate, Rohan, at the railway food stall. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'by chance'. 'came across' ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi se achanak milna', isliye iske sath 'by chance(achanak)' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: Meera asked her brother (a)/ that why he had not attended (b)/ their cousin's engagement ceremony. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'that'. Sentence indirect speech mein likha hai, toh 'asked' verb ke saath 'how, why, where, when' yehi conjunction ka kaam karte hai, aur iss sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction nahi aayegi.

questions.question: Kavya doesn't have sufficient enough savings (a)/ to manage her rent and groceries in Bengaluru (b)/ if she gets fired from her job. (a)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'sufficient' or 'enough'. 'sufficient' ka matlab hee 'enough' hota hai, isliye inn dono mein se koi ek ka use hoga.

questions.question: Muskan asked her brother (a)/ supposing if their train to Kolkata got cancelled due to heavy rains (b)/ what alternative route they could take (c)/ to reach there on time for the ceremony. (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'supposing' or 'if'. 'supposing' aur 'if' dono ek sath nahi aate, kyunki inn dono ka matlab same hota hai, isliye dono mein se ek hi lagayenge.

questions.question: Not until the results were announced (a)/ did she understand how well she (b)/ had performed in the examination. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: No error. 'Until' as a conjunction aajaye toh verb ke sath 'not' nahi aata, lekin 'until' ko qualify karne ke liye 'not' aa sakta hai, 'not until' structure use hota hai.

questions.question: The investigation revealed the true fact (a)/ that the fire in the Surat textile market (b)/ broke out owing to faulty wiring (c)/ and negligence of shop owners. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'true'. 'fact' humesha bolte usi ko hai jo true ho, isliye 'fact' ke sath 'true' superfluous hai.

questions.question: While travelling to Lucknow (a)/ Priya got stuck for hours (b)/ as it suddenly started raining like cats and dogs (c)/ near the Barabanki highway toll plaza. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'like'. 'raining cats and dogs' ka matlab hai 'raining heavily' matlab 'moosladhaar baarish', jisme 'cats and dogs' ka matlab 'heavily' hai matlab yeh adverb hai aur adverb se pehle 'like' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: Radhika had prepared extensively for (a)/ her CGL mains but because she fell sick (b)/ on the morning of the (c)/ exam, she couldn't give the test. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'give' with 'take'. Sentence ka matlab 'wo test nahi de paayi', toh grammar mein iske liye sahi word 'take' hai, isliye yahan 'she couldn't take the test' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The HR representative informed the (a)/ applicants that the team would revert back (b)/ to each of them individually (c)/ after thoroughly examining all the submitted documents. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'back'. 'revert' ka matlab hee hota hai 'answer back', isliye iske saath 'back' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: While driving late at night on the (a)/ Ahmedabad–Vadodara Expressway he slowed (b)/ down his bike when he (c)/ approached near the police barricade. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'near'. 'approached' ek transitive verb hai jiske baad object aayega, isliye 'approached' ke baad 'near' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: Before leaving for his night shift (a)/ Raghav requested his neighbour to kindly (b)/ look after his elderly father who(c)/ had been feeling unwell since the previous evening. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'kindly'. 'requested' ke sath 'kindly' ka use nahi hota kyunki dono ka meaning same hota hai, agar 'requested' pehle likha hai toh 'kindly' hatana padega.
